text.content:
Raiders who hit the roads in and out of the city.

Turf: Raider country in the Badlands north of Night City
Known for: Raiding convoys, kidnapping travelers, selling parts

Former nomads thrown out of their packs, the Wraiths prey on traffic heading to and from Night City through the Badlands. They hit convoys, kidnap travelers and sell parts. Nobody in the city claims them, and nobody has managed to wipe them out.

Edgerunner's Handbook p.28; Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.04, 13
